Start date: 1486-08-25  
Subtract 38 weeks = 38 × 7 = 266 days.  
Subtract 6 more days → total subtract 272 days.  

1486 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100, but 1486 not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before Aug 25 in 1486:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31 → sum to 212 days.  
Aug 25 → 31+28+31+30+31+30+31 + 25 = 237 days of year.  

Go back 272 days from day 237:  
237 − 272 = −35 days.  
So go into previous year 1485.  

1485 is not divisible by 4 → 365 days.  
365 − 35 = 330th day of 1485.  

1485 months: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30.  
Sum to end of Nov: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+30 = 334 days.  
330th day is 4 days before Dec 1 → Nov 26, 1485.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1485-11-26
